draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: OpenAI announced expanded advertiser access; the reader needs to distinguish a sponsored placement from ChatGPT's generated answer.
causalSequence: Reader describes a purchase and constraints in a conversation.
OpenAI says a separate ads system can use this context to select paid placement.
Answer and ad can therefore address the same need without the ad being the model's recommendation.
Turning off broader personalization does not remove current-chat ad selection.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A hypothetical team-lunch search supplies location and budget, which could make a restaurant ad relevant without endorsing that venue.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: An assistant helps choose payroll software; a sponsored vendor beside its answer remains paid placement even if personalization is off.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Identify which item is sponsored; evaluate its claims separately. No purchase, account change or upgrade is required.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Dated announcement and rollout caveat, connected mechanism with one case, precise control distinction.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: No mandatory prompt, lesson checklist, slogan or inflated conclusion.
